                    greeting, example_dialogue, voice_anchor, appearance_tags, outfit, default_tone,
                    default_reply_style, default_reply_custom, art_style, age, is_adult,
                    extensions_json, created_at)
             VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
             RETURNING id AS "id!"
